evidence: The resulting film thickness and the morphological structure in the nanoensembles obtained by ALD were mainly investigated by transmission electron microscopy (TEM) using a 100 kV JEOL microscope, while their chemical composition was determined by electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS) employing a probe-corrected FEI TITAN 80-300 microscope operated in the scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) mode at high voltages of 80 and 300 kV. In this mode, a high-angle annular dark field (HAADF) detector enables a spatial resolution of about 0.2 nm. The microscope is further equipped with a Gatan Tridiem 866 EEL spectrometer with an energy resolution of 0.6 eV.
